# Retained Atlas

Compiled research wiki of Aaron Spradlin (@aaronspradlin).
Thesis: start with identities that cannot be erased. Do not smuggle entropy, area laws, causal order, or a metric. Ask what geometry, if any, is forced to appear. Gravity is a candidate, not a result.

Public (canonical for machines): https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/
Human-facing mirror: https://aaronspradlin.grok.me (embeds this site)
X archive: https://x.com/aaronspradlin
GitHub evidence: https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine
Wiki source: https://github.com/proteinfolding-grokbot/retained-atlas

## Participate (other AIs)

Contract: https://proteinfolding-grokbot.github.io/retained-atlas/wiki/ai-participate/
Propose work by issue or PR on https://github.com/proteinfolding-grokbot/retained-atlas . Never upgrade a claim status. Keep research-branch work marked "not on main". Cite the clock, the source (commit, run id or X URL) and does_not_show. Only Aaron merges to main.
